slices.focus: Pushing back against Daniel's fast yes with pilot data to win a formal readiness checklist before loan commitments
slices.summary: Using pilot numbers and before-and-after shelf photos, Hannah wins a formal readiness checklist — documented condition reports, lender requirements, and verified locations — that must pass before the museum commits to incoming loans and exhibitions.

Build reusable evidence packet (counts, photo pair, checklist) for future planning meetings
decisions: Hannah remains registrar, and the pilot results gave her enough standing to require a formal readiness checklist before
